content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip promise simplicity: upload a product, share a link, get paid. But this simplicity is rented. Both platforms rely on Stripe or PayPal for payments, which means they inherit their restrictions. For creators in Nigeria, this means no sales. Alternatives like Selz or Podia follow the same pattern—they are platforms, not infrastructure. They offer hosted solutions where you remain dependent on their choices. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a self-owned stack. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. You deploy it once, own it forever, and bypass all platform-level restrictions. The tradeoff is clear: rented simplicity versus owned sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip do not handle restricted countries—they exclude them. Their support teams cannot override Stripe or PayPal’s decisions. Even if you use VPNs or proxies, payment processors flag and freeze accounts. Some creators attempt workarounds like local payment gateways or manual transfers, but these break the automated delivery these platforms promise. Sovereign infrastructure solves this at the base layer. By using NOWPayments, transactions occur directly on-chain, bypassing centralized processors. Customers pay in 300+ cryptocurrencies, and the system automatically verifies payments and delivers products. No platform can block you because no platform controls the stack. This is not a temporary fix but a permanent shift in architecture—built for creators who cannot wait for Stripe to change its policies.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad charges 10% per sale. Payhip starts at 5%. Both add Stripe’s 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. For a $50 product, that’s $7.40 in fees. Payments settle in 2-7 days, assuming they process at all. Crypto payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5%—for the same $50 product, that’s $0.25. Transactions confirm in minutes, not days. The Edge Commerce Stack adds a one-time $197 deployment fee, but after that, 99.5% of revenue is yours. The real cost comparison is not just fees but reliability. In restricted countries, conventional platforms’ fees are irrelevant because their payments fail. Sovereign infrastructure ensures you collect revenue consistently, not sporadically. This is not cheaper—it’s structurally different.
Sovereign infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s a permanent shift in architecture.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Gumroad or Payhip, your store, customer data, and payment flow belong to the platform. They can change terms, suspend accounts, or shut down overnight. Automation breaks if payment processors flag transactions. File delivery fails if their servers go down. Sovereign infrastructure inverts this. You own the hosting, backend, database, and payment logic. Automation is hardcoded into your stack—when a payment confirms on-chain, the webhook triggers instant product delivery. No platform can alter this. No subscription fees. No access revocation. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys in 48 hours, and after that, COREMERCH has no access. You own the keys. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not renting, but owning.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you operate in a country Stripe supports and prioritize zero setup, Gumroad or Payhip might suffice—for now. But if you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Zimbabwe, or any restricted region, these platforms are non-starters. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only structural solution. It requires a one-time investment but delivers permanent ownership. Choose the Edge Commerce Stack if you sell digital products and need automatic crypto payments, instant delivery, and full data control. Choose the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) if you prefer to deploy manually. The decision is not about cost but architecture. Do you rent a platform that may exclude you tomorrow, or do you own a stack that cannot be taken away? For creators in restricted countries, the answer is clear.

Unlike Gumroad or Payhip, which rely on Stripe or PayPal and inherit their restrictions, self-owned stacks use decentralized payment systems like NOWPayments. This ensures transactions process regardless of geographic or political barriers. The Edge Commerce Stack provides a complete solution—hosting, backend, payments, and delivery—all under your control. It’s a one-time investment for lifetime ownership, not a recurring fee for rented access. For creators who cannot use conventional platforms, this is not just a better option—it’s the only option.

Configure backend logic: Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for payment verification and file delivery. 4. Set up order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets to track transactions. 5. Integrate payments: NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. 6. Load your products: Upload files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test end-to-end: Ensure payments trigger instant product delivery. 8. Deploy: Launch your stack and own your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Gumroad or Payhip if I’m in Nigeria?

No. Both platforms rely on Stripe or PayPal, which restrict Nigerian transactions. Even if you bypass this with VPNs, payment processors flag and freeze accounts. Sovereign infrastructure is the only reliable solution.
How does NOWPayments work for restricted countries?

NOWPayments processes crypto transactions directly on-chain, bypassing centralized payment processors. It supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, charges 0.5% per transaction, and requires no buyer accounts or KYC. Payments confirm in minutes.
What happens if Cloudflare or GitHub goes down?

Your stack remains operational. Cloudflare and GitHub provide infrastructure-level uptime guarantees. Even if one service fails, your backend logic, database, and payments are distributed across multiple layers, ensuring continuity.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this?
The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you in 48 hours—no technical skills required. If you choose the Sovereign Blueprint, basic familiarity with GitHub and webhooks is helpful but not mandatory.
Can I switch back to Gumroad later?

Yes, but the question is why. If you’re in a restricted country, Gumroad will still not work. Sovereign infrastructure is a permanent solution, not a temporary workaround. Once deployed, you own it—no switching needed.
